sections.kicker: The agentic platform for AI-hybrid creative production
sections.title: From the first word to the final frame.
sections.lead: Write it, previsualise it, render it, review it, perform it — in one place, with a crew of agents, on every device.

sections.title: One platform. Three promises.
sections.lead: A production is a dozen tools and a dozen hand-offs. N’Brain puts it behind one surface and gives every stage its own AI director.

cards.title: Agentic
cards.text: Agents run each stage from the room you are in — and stop for your approval at every gate.

cards.title: On every device
cards.text: Desktop, tablet, phone. Shared sessions, roles, live cursors. MIDI, OSC, gamepad, camera.

cards.title: Yours to keep
cards.text: Your machines, your GPUs, your versions. Offline on a signed grant, or in the cloud.

sections.title: A real world and its digital double.
sections.lead: Every venue, street and set exists twice: measured in the real, rebuilt in the virtual. One dataset, shown as a plan or in 3D — side by side, always in step.
